name: An overdraft fee
prompt: A payment went out before your pay came in. The bank has charged an overdraft fee.

outcome.told: The fee comes out with the next deposit.

choices.text: Call the bank and ask them to waive it

outcome.told: You wait on hold, then explain to someone who has heard it before.
outcome.line: {you} talked a bank out of an overdraft fee.

failure.line: {you} asked a bank to waive an overdraft fee, and it didn't.
